(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((blocks (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 1))) (c (range 0 (- w 1)))
                              #:when
                              (and
                                (= (at g r c) 8)
                                (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 8)
                                (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 8)
                                (= (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 8)))
                            (list r c)))
                  (row-groups (let ((h (make-hash)))
                                (for-each (lambda (b)
                                            (let ((r (first b))
                                                  (c (second b)))
                                              (hash-set! h
                                                         r
                                                         (cons c (hash-ref h r (list))))))
                                          blocks)
                                h))
                  (sorted-rows (sort (hash-keys row-groups) <))
                  (strips (map (lambda (top-row)
                                 (let* ((cs (hash-ref row-groups top-row))
                                        (left-c (min-list cs))
                                        (right-c (max-list cs))
                                        (int-c1 (+ left-c 2))
                                        (int-c2 (- right-c 1))
                                        (strip (for/list ((r (list top-row (+ top-row 1))))
                                                 (for/list ((c (range int-c1 (+ int-c2 1))))
                                                   (at g r c)))))
                                   strip))
                               sorted-rows))
                  (all-rows (apply append strips))
                  (out-h (length all-rows))
                  (out-w (length (first all-rows))))
             (build-grid out-h out-w (r c) (list-ref (list-ref all-rows r) c))))))

                                   strip))
                               sorted-rows))
                  (key-values (apply append (first strips)))
                  (key (first (sort (remove-duplicates key-values)
                         (lambda (a b)
                           (let ((na (count-if (lambda (v) (= v a)) key-values))
                                 (nb (count-if (lambda (v) (= v b)) key-values)))
                             (if (= na nb) (< a b) (> na nb)))))))
                  (ordered-strips (sort strips
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (> (count-if (lambda (v) (= v key)) (apply append a))
                            (count-if (lambda (v) (= v key)) (apply append b))))))
                  (all-rows (apply append ordered-strips))
                  (out-h (length all-rows))
                  (out-w (length (first all-rows))))
             (build-grid out-h out-w (r c) (list-ref (list-ref all-rows r) c))))))
